objects.name: Electronic health record company CareCloud says 3.7 million people affected by breach
objects.description: Healthcare software firm CareCloud filed documents with the Department of Health and Human Services confirming that 3,756,469 people had information leaked after a hacker spent eight hours in one of the company’s electronic health record environments.
